result.card: Adds a Python implementation of BIP352 silent payment scanning without labels and script pattern-matching utilities to the functional test framework. The implementation is tested against official BIP352 receiving test vectors within the framework unit tests. This allows functional tests to independently check silent payment outputs without relying on bitcoind logic. It was split out from PR 35302 (Silent Payments: Sending) to simplify review.

risk.why: Touches only Python functional test helpers and build files for test vectors, with no impact on consensus or node binaries.
